```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

```


https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/themes/world-health-statistics

https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/indicators/indicator-details/GHO/life-expectancy-at-birth-(years)

```{r data}

who_life_expectancy_pred_df <- read.csv('datasets/who_life_expectancy.csv') %>%
  transmute(IND_NAME = Indicator,
            DIM_GEO_NAME = Location,
            IND_CODE = IndicatorCode,
            DIM_GEO_CODE = SpatialDimValueCode,
            DIM_TIME_YEAR = Period,
            DIM_1_CODE = Dim1ValueCode,
            VALUE_NUMERIC = FactValueNumeric,
            VALUE_STRING = Value,
            VALUE_COMMENTS = NA)

who_life_expectancy_long_df <- read.csv('datasets/who_life_expectancy_indicators.csv') %>%
  bind_rows(who_life_expectancy_pred_df) %>%
  mutate(field_value = if_else(
    is.na(DIM_1_CODE), as.character(IND_CODE), 
    paste0(IND_CODE, "__", DIM_1_CODE)
    ))

value_definitions_df <- who_life_expectancy_long_df %>%
  mutate(name = paste0("N_COUNTRIES_", DIM_TIME_YEAR)) %>%
  group_by(IND_NAME, IND_CODE, field_value, name) %>%
  summarise(COUNT = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(IND_NAME, IND_CODE, field_value),
              values_from = COUNT,
              names_from = name)

years <- sort(unique(who_life_expectancy_long_df$DIM_TIME_YEAR))

who_life_expectancy_dfs <- list()

for (year in years) {
  append(who_life_expectancy_dfs, who_life_expectancy_long_df %>% 
           filter(DIM_TIME_YEAR == year) %>%
           pivot_wider(id_cols = c(DIM_GEO_CODE, DIM_GEO_NAME, DIM_TIME_YEAR),
              names_from = field_value,
              values_from = VALUE_NUMERIC,
              names_sep = "__"))
}

who_life_expectancy_dfs <- lapply(years, function(year) {
  who_life_expectancy_long_df %>%
    filter(DIM_TIME_YEAR == year) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(DIM_GEO_CODE, DIM_GEO_NAME, DIM_TIME_YEAR),
      names_from = field_value,
      values_from = VALUE_NUMERIC,
      names_sep = "__"
    )
})

names(who_life_expectancy_dfs) <- paste0('df_', years)


who_life_expectancy_2019_df <- who_life_expectancy_dfs$df_2019 %>%
  select(DIM_GEO_CODE, DIM_GEO_NAME, DIM_TIME_YEAR, 
         WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_000001__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_000001__SEX_FMLE,
         WHOSIS_000015__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_000015__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_000015__SEX_FMLE,
         SDGAIRBODA__SEX_BTSX, NCD_HYP_PREVALENCE_A__SEX_BTSX, SDGPM25, SDGWSHBOD__SEX_BTSX,
         NUTRITION_ANAEMIA_REPRODUCTIVEAGE_PREV__SEX_FMLE, NCDMORT3070, 
         SA_0000001688__SEX_BTSX) %>%
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))


who_life_expectancy_2020_df <- who_life_expectancy_dfs$df_2020 %>%
  select(DIM_GEO_CODE, DIM_GEO_NAME, DIM_TIME_YEAR, 
         WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_000001__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_000001__SEX_FMLE,
         WHOSIS_000015__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_000015__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_000015__SEX_FMLE,
         SDGHEPHBSAGPRV, MDG_0000000026) %>%
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))

who_life_expectancy_2021_df <- who_life_expectancy_dfs$df_2021 %>%
    transmute(DIM_GEO_CODE, DIM_GEO_NAME, DIM_TIME_YEAR, 
         WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_000001__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_000001__SEX_FMLE,
         WHOSIS_000015__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_000015__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_000015__SEX_FMLE,
         WHOSIS_0001__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_0001__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_0001__SEX_FMLE,  
         WHOSIS_0002__SEX_BTSX, WHOSIS_0002__SEX_MLE, WHOSIS_0002__SEX_FMLE,  
         SDGSUICIDE, SDGPOISON, VIOLENCE_HOMICIDERATE, GHED_GGHE_DGGE_SHA2011 = `GHED_GGHE-DGGE_SHA2011`, 
         UHC_INDEX_REPORTED, RS_198) %>%
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))

indicators_to_keep <- value_definitions_df %>%
  filter(N_COUNTRIES_2022 >= 0.5 * length(unique(who_life_expectancy_long_df$DIM_GEO_NAME))) %>%
  pull(IND_CODE)

who_life_expectancy_2022_df <- who_life_expectancy_dfs$df_2022 %>%
  select(WHOSIS_000003__SEX_BTSX, 
         NCD_BMI_30A__SEX_BTSX, M_Est_tob_curr_std__SEX_BTSX, SDGODAWS, WHS4_100, SDGHPVRECEIVED__SEX_FMLE, MALARIA_EST_INCIDENCE,
         MCV2, WHOSIS_000003__SEX_BTSX, SDGHIV__SEX_BTSX, PCV3, NCD_BMI_PLUS2C__SEX_BTSX, NUTOVERWEIGHTPREV, NUTSTUNTINGPREV,
         WSH_WATER_SAFELY_MANAGED, WSH_SANITATION_SAFELY_MANAGED, PHE_HHAIR_PROP_POP_CLEAN_FUELS, WSH_DOMESTIC_WASTE_SAFELY_TREATED,
         SDGNTDTREATMENT, SDGODA01, MDG_0000000020, MDG_0000000007__SEX_BTSX)



who_life_expectancy_df <- who_life_expectancy_long_df %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(DIM_GEO_CODE, DIM_GEO_NAME, DIM_TIME_YEAR),
              names_from = field_value,
              values_from = VALUE_NUMERIC,
              names_sep = "__")

```

```{r new-model}

le_2019_lm <- lm(WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX ~ SDGAIRBODA__SEX_BTSX + NCD_HYP_PREVALENCE_A__SEX_BTSX + SDGPM25 + SDGWSHBOD__SEX_BTSX +
         NUTRITION_ANAEMIA_REPRODUCTIVEAGE_PREV__SEX_FMLE + NCDMORT3070 +
         SA_0000001688__SEX_BTSX, data = who_life_expectancy_2019_df)

le_2019_lm_2 <- lm(WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX ~ SDGWSHBOD__SEX_BTSX + NUTRITION_ANAEMIA_REPRODUCTIVEAGE_PREV__SEX_FMLE + NCDMORT3070, data = who_life_expectancy_2019_df)

le_2020_lm <- lm(WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX ~ SDGHEPHBSAGPRV + MDG_0000000026, data = who_life_expectancy_2020_df)

le_2021_lm <- lm(WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX ~ SDGSUICIDE + SDGPOISON + VIOLENCE_HOMICIDERATE + 
   GHED_GGHE_DGGE_SHA2011 + UHC_INDEX_REPORTED + RS_198, data = who_life_expectancy_2021_df)

le_2021_lm_2 <- lm(WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX ~ SDGSUICIDE + SDGPOISON + VIOLENCE_HOMICIDERATE + 
                     UHC_INDEX_REPORTED + RS_198, data = who_life_expectancy_2021_df) ##

summary(le_2019_lm)
summary(le_2019_lm_2)

summary(le_2020_lm)

summary(le_2021_lm)
summary(le_2021_lm_2)

plot(le_2021_lm)

# The wonderful country of Gutagong

predict(le_2021_lm, data.frame(SDGSUICIDE = 24,
                          SDGPOISON = 2,
                          VIOLENCE_HOMICIDERATE = 38, 
                          GHED_GGHE_DGGE_SHA2011 = 11,
                          UHC_INDEX_REPORTED = 42,
                          RS_198 = 15))

```

```{r cv}

# Load the caret package for cross-validation
library(caret)

# Set up 10-fold cross-validation
train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

# Train the model with cross-validation
le_2021_lm_cv <- train(
  WHOSIS_000001__SEX_BTSX ~ SDGSUICIDE + SDGPOISON + VIOLENCE_HOMICIDERATE + UHC_INDEX_REPORTED + RS_198,
  data = who_life_expectancy_2021_df,
  method = "lm",
  trControl = train_control
)

# Output the results
print(le_2021_lm_cv)


plot(le_2021_lm_cv$finalModel)

```
